The '''Abaarian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] containing the planet [[Abaarian]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this system was located in space controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It would later become a member state of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
